welcome.title: Welcome to Iris
welcome.intro: Iris lets low-income households reserve, for free, surplus goods offered by B.A.D.R. and its partner stores, then pick them up with a code.
welcome.householdText: B.A.D.R. checks your income with your notice of assessment. Once your file is approved, you reserve listings near you.
welcome.partnerText: Give your surplus instead of throwing it away. B.A.D.R. reviews every partner application.
